name: 28539 · Hubert, NC
findings: ZIP 28539 (Hubert) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 3 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28539 (Hubert) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
